card.name: Cumbia
card.profile: Folk dance-music of Colombia's Caribbean coast (Momposina region/Magdalena delta) blending African drums, Indigenous flutes and Spanish elements (Wikipedia; Colombia Country Brand). Danced in a circle around the musicians; the woman holds lit candles in her right hand and her skirt in the left, the man circles holding a sombrero vueltiao, partners not touching. Traditional ensemble: tambora, tambor alegre, llamador, gaita hembra/macho, flauta de millo, guache, maracas.
card.insight: 'Cumbia tradicional del Caribe colombiano' was approved by Colombia's Consejo Nacional de Patrimonio Cultural in 2022 and formalized by Resolucion DM No. 0321 de 2024 - an administrative LRPCI inscription, not a law of Congress (Radio Nacional; Semana).

steps.name: Cumbia Basic Step
steps.description: Rock back and step in place with quick-quick-slow rhythm.

steps.name: Side to Side Basic Step
steps.description: Step side to side accenting beats 5 and 7.

cues: push your body back to center
lessons.teacher_style: The instructor breaks down steps systematically, showing both solo and partner variations from the front and back. He pairs verbal explanations with counting and demonstration to guide learners.
lessons.distinctive_method: Turning around to face away from the camera so students can follow footwork directly without mirror reversal.
what_works: Clear counting and demonstration from the back view making it easy to follow along.

evidence.observation: Instructor demonstrates basic cumbia steps facing forward with quick-quick-slow rhythm
Instructor turns to face the back while explaining footwork starting with the left leg
Counting out loud 1-2-3 5-6-7 while stepping back

observation.setting: an outdoor paved public plaza in front of a historic building, with many onlookers sitting and standing
observation.dancers: a large group of mixed couples and individual dancers of various ages, including teenagers, adults, and seniors
observation.formation_and_space: couples scattered across the plaza dancing independently in closed space, some moving in circular pathways or small rotations
observation.posture: upright torso, relaxed knees with continuous weight shifts
observation.footwork: repetitive side-to-side stepping on the beat, low to the ground; exact heel-toe action and weight changes are partially occluded
observation.arms_and_hands: couples mostly in closed ballroom hold, some couples holding hands apart, others dancing solo with arms moving naturally
observation.hips_and_torso: gentle hip motion and swaying following the rhythm of the step
observation.partnering: closed dance hold with partners embracing, lead and follow via frame and torso connection
observation.levels_jumps_turns: low level, no jumps, occasional simple turns of the follower under the arm
observation.costume_and_props: casual everyday clothing including jeans, shirts, dresses, cowboy hats, caps, and face masks
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement and weight transfer cannot be determined precisely due to camera distance and wide-angle crowd perspective
